21.name: SCHEDULE
21.purpose: Timer/schedule engine with ten subunits (1 ventilation preset/boost/away, 2 bypass, 3 temperature profile, 5 ComfoCool, 6 supply fan, 7 exhaust fan, 8 auto/manual; 4, 9, 10 undocumented). Every timed override goes through 0x84 ENABLETIMERENTRY / 0x85 DISABLETIMERENTRY; plain GET-ONE reads only return two header bytes per subunit, and the timer state needs 0x83 GETTIMERENTRY, which the probe does not send. The firmware writes subunits 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8 (fan, ventilation_mode, away_mode, boost, bypass_mode, temperature_profile, balance_mode).

22.name: VALVE
22.purpose: Valve unit, presumably for the bypass, preheater and extract (not documented by Zehnder; not confirmed here). Two subunits answer, each with a u16 1000 and a text '100.0'; which valve each subunit is, is undocumented. Bypass position itself is PDO 227.

23.name: FAN
23.purpose: The two fans (presumably supply and exhaust). Over RMI only header bytes answer; live fan duty/flow/speed are PDOs 117-122.

24.name: POWERSENSOR
24.purpose: Power metering (presumably counts ventilation wattage and accumulates per year and since reset; not documented by Zehnder; not confirmed here). Over RMI only the generic byte answers; the figures themselves are PDOs 128-130.

25.name: PREHEATER
25.purpose: Optional internal pre-heater for frost protection, fitted as standard on this 'VV' unit (model string). RMI exposes five small values (an on/off-shaped switch, a u16 and a 0-100 value); power/energy are PDOs 144-146.

26.name: HMI
26.purpose: The unit's display and buttons: an inferred display language (the text ENGLISH) and an inferred brightness setting (70, 10-100 step 5), plus undocumented bytes; property 0x09 answered the undocumented RMI error 53.

27.name: RFCOMMUNICATION
27.purpose: Wireless communication with RF ancillaries (RFZ, Timer RF, CO2 RF via a ComfoSense C). Exposes a 0-2 and a 0-1 setting whose domains match the user manual's RF SENSOR PRIORITY (off/auto only/on) and RF SENSOR FUNCTION (flow proportional/flow preset); no RF device is paired here.

28.name: FILTER
28.purpose: Filter maintenance settings: filter lifetime (180 days) and an inferred pre-warning period (21 days). The live countdown is PDO 192; no reset command is documented (the on-unit filter wizard resets it).

29.name: TEMPHUMCONTROL
29.purpose: Temperature and humidity control: RMOT heating/cooling season limits, temperature passive / humidity comfort / humidity protection (off/auto only/on), adaptive vs fixed profile mode, and the fixed target temperature for warm/normal/cool profiles. The firmware writes properties 0x04/0x06/0x07.

30.name: VENTILATIONCONFIG
30.purpose: Ventilation configuration: airflow presets away/low/medium/high in m3/h (live ranges bound by the neighbouring presets), altitude band, flow-control vs constant-flow, bathroom-switch delays and mode, unbalance (+/-15.0 %), and a block of undocumented i16 values that look like stored commissioning measurements.

31.purpose: Absent on this unit: the discovery read (subunit 1, property 0x01) was answered with RMI error 12 (Unknown Unit). Provides no functionality here.

32.name: NODECONFIGURATION
32.purpose: Installer configuration: maintainer password (always redacted by the probe), orientation (right), and undocumented bytes. DO NOT send 0x80/0x82 to this unit (can break the configuration).

33.name: TEMPERATURESENSOR
33.purpose: Six temperature-sensor subunits, index-aligned with PDOs 273-278 (2 extract, 3 exhaust, 4 outdoor, 5 after pre-heater, 6 supply). Property 0x02 reads 1 for the four physical sensors and 0 for subunits 1 and 5 (5 is the derived after-pre-heater point).

34.name: HUMIDITYSENSOR
34.purpose: Six humidity-sensor subunits, index-aligned with PDOs 289-294 (2 extract, 3 exhaust, 4 outdoor, 5 after pre-heater, 6 supply); same 0/1 pattern on property 0x02 as the temperature sensors.

35.name: PRESSURESENSOR
35.purpose: The two static-pressure sensors (supply and exhaust side) that the unit's computed airflow relies on; both read 1 on property 0x02.

36.name: PERIPHERALS
36.purpose: Peripheral bookkeeping (presumably stores the ID of an attached ComfoCool and can reset peripheral errors; not documented by Zehnder; not confirmed here). Ten u8 slots, all 0 - no peripheral is registered, consistent with only node 1 on the bus.

37.name: ANALOGINPUT
37.purpose: Four Option Box 0-10 V inputs. Each subunit carries the per-input settings the installer manual lists for 0-10V 1..4 (input at 0 %, input at 100 %, method, setpoint, proportional band, integral time); the values equal the manual's factory defaults exactly. No Option Box is fitted here. Live voltages are PDOs 369-372.

38.name: COOKERHOOD
38.purpose: Placeholder ('dummy') unit for a ComfoHood; only the generic byte answers. No hood is connected.

39.name: POSTHEATER
39.purpose: Optional post-heater (driven through an Option Box). Three settings answer (100 in 50-150, 180 in 60-600 s-shaped, 300 in 100-520); none is named by any source. Supply temperature after the post-heater is PDO 221. Not fitted here.

40.name: COMFOFOND
40.purpose: Placeholder ('dummy') unit for the ComfoFond ground heat exchanger; only the generic byte answers. ComfoFond data travels as PDOs 416-419.

41.purpose: Present but undocumented: only property 0x01 (=1, generic byte) answers.

42.purpose: Present but undocumented: three u8 zeros, four i16 zeros and ten i16 slots all reading -400 (= -40.0 if tenths of a degree, a plausible 'no sensor' placeholder). Purpose unknown.

43.name: CO2SENSOR
43.purpose: CO2 sensor zones: eight identical subunits whose property 0x01 is a one-hot zone bit (1..128), matching PDO 230 bits 47-54 (CO2ZoneX1..8) and the eight 'CO2 sensor zone' registers of the ComfoConnect Pro. Each zone holds ppm thresholds (2000/400/1050, 0-2000 step 50) and PI-style settings (50, 300 s). No CO2 sensor is fitted.

Bypass and profile commands themselves are SCHEDULE timers.

heating-and-frost.title: Heating and frost protection
heating-and-frost.summary: Pre-heater (PREHEATER 0x19, fitted on this 'VV' unit), post-heater settings (POSTHEATER 0x27, Option Box accessory, not fitted) and ComfoFond ground heat exchanger placeholder (COMFOFOND 0x28).

filters-and-maintenance.title: Filters and maintenance
filters-and-maintenance.summary: Filter lifetime and pre-warning period in days (FILTER 0x1C). No filter-reset RMI command is documented.

sensors-and-air-quality.title: Sensors and air quality
sensors-and-air-quality.summary: Per-sensor subunits for the six temperature and six humidity positions and the two pressure sensors, the four Option Box 0-10 V inputs with their scaling/PI settings, and eight CO2 sensor zones with ppm thresholds and PI settings.

schedules-and-timers.title: Schedules and timers
schedules-and-timers.summary: The ten-subunit SCHEDULE unit (0x15) that carries every timed override (level, boost, away, bypass, profile, supply/exhaust only, auto/manual). Plain GET-ONE reads only return header bytes; timer state needs 0x83 GETTIMERENTRY.

errors-and-alarms.title: Errors and alarms
errors-and-alarms.summary: ERROR unit (0x03): active-error bitfield via 0x80 GETACTIVEERRORS (all clear in this walk) and RESETALLERRORS (0x82).

communication-and-network.title: Communication and network
communication-and-network.summary: ComfoNet/ComfoBus bookkeeping (COMFOBUS 0x02), the RF unit for wireless ancillaries (RFCOMMUNICATION 0x1B) and stored peripheral slots (PERIPHERALS 0x24).

configuration-and-installer.title: Configuration and installer settings
configuration-and-installer.summary: NODECONFIGURATION (0x20): maintainer password (never reported), orientation, and several undocumented installer bytes whose domains match fire-place/heat-exchanger/service-mode style switches.

display-and-hmi.title: Display and HMI
display-and-hmi.summary: The unit's own display (HMI 0x1A): display language, brightness and a few undocumented bytes.

energy-and-power.title: Energy and power
energy-and-power.summary: POWERSENSOR (0x18). Over RMI it exposes only a generic byte; the actual power/energy figures are PDOs 128-130 (fans) and 144-146 (pre-heater).

other.title: Other / unidentified
other.summary: Units that are absent (error 12) or present but undocumented (0x29, 0x2A, 0x2C, COOKERHOOD placeholder).
